title: cornus stolonifera var. baileyi
intro: Cornus stolonifera var. baileyi, commonly known as Red-osier Dogwood, is a deciduous shrub native to North America, known for its vibrant red stems and white or pink flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cornus stolonifera var. baileyi are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
